QuestInfo.name: [Celestial] Princess Parade
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Princess Parade>#n

This year at the festival, a princess of unmatched beauty is to be honored with a parade! Cheer alongside the princess's parade float which appears at the 30-min mark every hour, every day #bfrom 10 AM to 11:59 PM#k, and receive special gifts from the princess herself!
